title: Embedded integral residue transport
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite intermediate field in PadicAlgCl ell with the transported finite-dimensional structure on ULift E, pi a generator of the maximal ideal of its embedded integers, X a Noetherian scheme in universe u, and e any isomorphism from the condensed commutative ring object of continuous embedded integers to the spectral integer ring object on ULift E. For every complex K of continuous embedded integral modules, restriction along the inverse image of e inverse transports the constructible-cohomology and finite-relative-Tor-amplitude condition on the first constant reduction to the same condition on the spectral first constant reduction. No completeness is assumed.

source.place: Displayed criterion: transport of the local completeness and first-residue predicates; Stacks Tag 09C1.

proof.text: Obtain commuting isomorphisms d and r on the ordinary constant integer and first-residue coefficients from the coefficient-square lemma. Pull them to X with upperStarFromPoint.

Restriction along d and r gives exact equivalences of module categories. The quotient square gives a natural isomorphism between the two composites of scalar restrictions. Derive it and use uniqueness of left adjoints to identify derived quotient extension followed by restriction along r inverse with restriction along d inverse followed by derived quotient extension. The scalar square then identifies the two reductions of the given K.

Finite Tor amplitude bounds cohomology by the unit-tensor test. Apply the existing constant-model constructible finite-Tor coefficient-isomorphism theorem to each reduction. Apply it also to the inverse coefficient isomorphism and use the derived equivalence unit to reflect the condition. Finally transport the condition through the derived reduction comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem embeddedIntegralResidueTransport
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] (ULift.{u} E.val)]
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1))
    (e : Mon.mk (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj.{u} ℓ E.val) ≅
      sfbCondensedIntegers ℓ (ULift.{u} E.val))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (K : DerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (integralCoefficientObject X ℓ E))) :
    IntegralModelsEmbedded.residueConstructible ℓ E π X
      ((IntegralModelsEmbedded.restriction ℓ E X).obj K) ↔
    IntegralModelsStacks.residueCondition ℓ (ULift.{u} E.val) X
      ((IntegralModelsStacks.restriction ℓ (ULift.{u} E.val) X).obj
        ((Mod.comap ((upperStarFromPoint X).map
            e.inv.hom)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          K))
